## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D1 (b, clinical components). This is audit backlog UX-03 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: Components only, in /__ui. Later the consultation, nurse intake and long forms.
Findings and reviewers: F-10, F-03 (status), F-26 · reviewers B-01, A-03, A-15. Part 2 of 3 of audit backlog UX-03; SaveStatus is also used by audit backlog UX-04.
Rationale: The floating Review and sign bar covers fields and hid 2 of 45 tab stops (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 at risk). The save message is a fixed sentence that cannot say Not saved.
Proposed UX behaviour: StickyActionBar is a footer row that is part of the page layout: it reserves its own height (56 px), holds status text at the start and the commit actions at the end, sets scroll-padding-bottom on its scroll container, and un-pins at 400 % zoom. It never overlays content. SaveStatus shows one of three states in one fixed place: Saving…, Saved with the time (for example Saved 10:42), or Not saved. Trying again. It is a polite live region, changes by an opacity swap of 150 ms (instant under reduced motion), has no tick animation and no toast, and never shows Saved unless told the server answered.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, doctor view, audit note 7; blueprint sections 7, 10 and 12.
Components and tokens affected: New sticky-action-bar.tsx and save-status.tsx in packages/ui; the motion tokens; i18n keys for the three states in en, hi and ar.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the D1a tickets for control defaults and type tokens. File ownership: its two files, their tests and gallery section.
Clinical sign-off: Not required for the components. The sign bar's behaviour on the consultation is validated with the screen ticket.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Wiring to the note controller (audit backlog UX-04, track S). (2) Putting the footer on the consultation (the screen ticket in wave D2). (3) Any change to what Sign or Authorise do.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a long page in the gallery with the footer, when the last field is scrolled to, then the whole field is visible above the footer
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the gallery page, when every control is reached with Tab, then each focused element is fully inside the visible area and none is under the footer
- [ ] **AC3.** Given SaveStatus, when it is set to saving, saved at 10:42 and failed, then it reads Saving…, Saved 10:42 and Not saved. Trying again., and it cannot render Saved without a time
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a screen reader and reduced motion, when the state changes, then the new text is announced once and swaps with no movement
- [ ] **AC5.** Given 400 % zoom, when the page scrolls, then the footer scrolls with the content
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the gallery in English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation

## Test notes

- Vitest: the state machine of SaveStatus.
- Playwright on /__ui: tab through, assert each focused element's box is inside the viewport minus pinned chrome; en and ar; axe.

- Regression risk: low.
